scope: Continuation of the stated one-shot empirical next step after completed qualification; only the exact 259 confirmatory survivors and 20362 original edges.
estimator: Mean valid cross-locality sequence-pair uncorrected p-distance, with >=ceil(0.5*alignment_length) jointly canonical columns; endpoint-disjoint OLS on log1p(chord distance km); z(post-IBD residual) on z(M_host), z(M_self), z(D_host_0BP); studentized equal-species mean beta_host.
p_value: (1 + number of fixed 1999 survivor null-reference statistics >= observed statistic)/2000
reference_provenance: The saved private survivor simulator uses the canonical 64-hex original source ID and reproduces the previously reported 30/500 and 485/500 outcomes. The public prototype retained an earlier truncated source-ID seed. This authorization binds the actually assessed private simulator and its exact reference series, not an interchangeable seed variant.
undefined_response_policy: Terminal NOT_EVALUABLE for the whole frozen panel if any species has an undefined standardized empirical response; no post-outcome species drop, replacement, or invented coefficient.
independent_numerical_checks: Full OLS verification of every partial beta and explicit endpoint-disjoint fits on the predetermined first/middle/last edge of every species, absolute tolerance 1e-9.
